# HexPiece 2.3.1

Your One Piece armor, from the pack you sent (`OnePiece_Armor_1.20.1.zip`, kept unaltered): wearable by players and by the Marines,
with its own creative tab. Nothing here has been tested in game yet. The build's checks and tests pass, and every piece was rendered
from the pack's own model and textures, the way the game draws armor, and checked (`docs/images/one-piece-armor.png`).

## The armor
- Seven items: **Marine Cap**, **Marine Shirt**, **Marine Trousers**, **Marine Boots** (each piece on its own), the **Admiral's
  Coat**, the **Straw Hat** and **Blackbeard's Coat**. They protect like iron armor, as your outfits do in HexGhoul.
- They are drawn by the pack's own 3D models with its textures. Sleeves fit both slim and wide arms, and the coats' tails follow the
  legs when you walk.
- A new creative tab, **One Piece Armor**, holds all seven. The katanas keep their own tab.
- **Marines spawn in the full Marine outfit** (cap, shirt, trousers, boots). No NPC ever spawns with the Admiral's Coat, the Straw
  Hat or Blackbeard's Coat. Pirates spawn without armor for now. A Marine may drop a piece now and then, as any mob drops its armor.

## Also
- The showcase of the Haki slash and the finisher is in `docs/images/slash-finisher-showcase.mp4`.

## Unchanged
Everything else is as in 2.3.0 (the crash on boot fixed). The network protocol is the same as 2.2.1.
